title: Shall androids dream of genocides? How generative AI can change the future of memorialization of mass atrocities

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical review and conceptual analysis examining how generative AI training data may enforce Western-centric hegemonic narratives and silence or erase the experiences of minority groups in the context of mass atrocity memorialization.

Qualitative discussion of how AI systems can be programmed or exploited to facilitate algorithm-driven 'masked censorship', enforce authoritarian state ideologies, and consolidate national memory regimes.
Conceptual evaluation of the risks associated with AI hallucinating facts, generating distorted visual and textual representations, and amplifying genocide denialism and historical revisionism.
